description: A yellow “Solid Wood Mancala” box sits on the tabletop with a black-and-yellow tape measure beside it. The right hand picks up the tape measure (right-hand object) and pulls the yellow tape out across the top of the box while the left hand steadies the tape’s end against the box edge (two-hand object), then the right hand retracts and repositions the tape to measure the other side, briefly holding it upright along the box before letting it retract again.
